claims.evidence: Sensor spec cannot be confirmed from exterior photos; no internal or spec-label shot provided.
Performance specs require a functional test, not shown in photos.
AF system cannot be verified from static photos; no menu/settings screen shown.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the body and retail box both clearly labeled 'Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit', not D3400.

risks.risk: Seller claims D3400 but witness-confirmed item is D3300, a real model mismatch that affects value (D3400 has Bluetooth, D3300 does not).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model nameplate on the camera body top/front, matching or contradicting the box.
risks.if_unproven: Price strictly as the witness-confirmed D3300, not the seller-claimed D3400.

risks.risk: No power-on, shutter, or autofocus test shown; internal function unknown.
risks.proof: Short video of camera powering on, firing shutter, and autofocusing on a subject.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-functional / worst case until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, dust, haze) not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements held up to light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically/optically compromised until clear glass is shown.

risks.risk: Shutter count / usage history unknown, affects remaining lifespan value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-usage/unknown-wear unit until shutter count is shown.

risks.risk: No battery, charger, memory card, or strap confirmed as included.
risks.proof: Photo showing these accessories laid out together with the camera and lens.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-and-lens only, no accessories included.

risks.risk: LCD screen and sensor condition (dead pixels, scratches, sensor dust/scratches) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of LCD screen powered on displaying an image, and a test shot at small aperture showing sensor dust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified screen/sensor condition, assume moderate wear.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents, cracks, mount wear) not visible from only two angles.
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, bottom, and lens mount close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible unseen cosmetic/structural damage.

proof_requests: Close-up of the model nameplate on the camera body to resolve D3300 vs D3400 discrepancy.
Video of camera powering on, shutter firing, and autofocus engaging.
Close-up photos of front and rear lens glass under light.
Screenshot or display of shutter count.
Photo of all accessories included in the sale (battery, charger, memory card, strap).
Photo of LCD screen powered on and a test image for sensor condition.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II kit from both body and box, so it can be priced at worst case despite the seller's contradicted D3400 claim and several unverified functional risks.
